analysis.reason: 직전 매수 판단(RSI 37.1) 이후 3거래일 연속 하락했으나, RSI 36.3으로 과매도 구간 진입 후 횡보 중. MACD 히스토그램은 여전히 음수이나 개선 추세 확인. 5일 저가 1,027,000원 대비 현재가 1,035,000원으로 소폭 반등하며 Higher Low 패턴 시도 중. 볼린저밴드 하단 접근 구간에서 반등 가능성 고려.
analysis.reasonEn: Despite 3 consecutive sessions of decline after the previous buy signal (RSI 37.1), RSI is now hovering at 36.3, having entered oversold territory. MACD histogram remains negative but shows improvement. A slight rebound from the 5-day low of 1,027,000 to the current 1,035,000 attempts a Higher Low pattern. Considering rebound potential near the lower Bollinger Band.

· Position relative to SMA100 (1,608,915 KRW) / SMA200 (1,532,432 KRW): Below long-term trends, maintaining strong weakness.
· 52-week position (21.5%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (38.4→36.3): Staying in oversold territory, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-6177.9987→-1948.2409): Weakness persists but improvement trend confirmed.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Near lower band 957,191 KRW) + Bandwidth at 44.59% level interpretation.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (808,000 KRW) + Based on Pivot S1 (845,667 KRW).
· Swing Resistance (1,060,000 KRW) + Expectation of short-term rebound upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Attempting Higher Low) + Potential for recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.82x): Reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Rebound attempt within a downtrend) + Buy entry conditions considered.
